source: 2026-11-02 T156: cluster positions are map units (same as planets.json x,y), template values until T157 sees them on the map. Richness, yield and how many clusters are active come from balance.json: mining_cluster_richness, mining_yield_per_cycle, mining_clusters_s1, mining_clusters_s2 (the first N clusters of a system in this list are active). count = pack instances T157 draws at full richness; they thin as ore is taken. event_cluster = shape of the small cluster EV20 leaves when the player pays (richness: mining_event_cluster_richness).
